heading_script_line: Room to Play, Build and Pretend.
body_text: Play corners where children touch, explore, build and pretend, and choose, collaborate and discover.

items.title: Block & Construction Play
items.text: Blocks may become a bridge, a city or a home.

items.title: Sensory Play
items.text: Sand, water, dough and natural objects to touch, feel and experiment with.

items.title: Reading & Role-Play Corners
items.text: Quiet spaces for stories and lively spaces for pretend play.
